# Item #3331: feat(roadmap): stage requires an eval replay task when a plan edits the stage prompt or gates

## Problem

`docs/ROADMAP_WORKFLOW.md` says that a pull request that changes the stage prompt or a check of the
stage job states the score of the same model before and after the change. A plan that changes one of
these paths often holds no task that runs `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay`.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A plan that changes the stage prompt or a stage gate with no replay task is refused.
- [ ] A plan that changes the stage prompt or a stage gate with the replay task and the score passes.
